column2: Hey, Ban-chan, when we borrowed gas money from Hevn-san in advance,
you said we'd pay her back ten times over... Is that really okay?
Couldn't be helped. She wouldn't have lent it to us otherwise.
Besides, once the fee comes in, gas money's nothing...
That insane driving...
That's gotta be old man Maguruma behind the wheel.
Do you think Himiko-chan and Akabane-san are there too?
That's what we're about to find out. Let's go, Ginji!
All right, gotcha!
! They're running us off the road?!
One wrong move and they'll go over into the gorge too!
Th-this is bad, Ban-chan! At this rate...
No good! We won't make it!!
...That was easier than I expected.
Wahahahahaha!!
Wahaha...?! Blast, that jolt did somethin' to the steering...
This is bad! At this rate we'll crash into the gas station!
No good! I can't control it, I tell ya!!
Kyaaaaah!!
Enjoy the nightmare?
Th-the Evil Eye?! In that split second?
Sorry, but we've taken back the costume!!
And while I was at it, I popped all your tires.
Now even Mr. No-Brake can't do a damn thing, right?
Grrgh...
See ya. You three enjoy a nice, leisurely drive!
The GetBackers are gettin' away!
Heh... At times, cowardice is a weapon too. Isn't that right, Lady Poison?
Right... What they took is a fake I swapped in.
Now if we can just reach N Hall before they notice...
Then I know a shortcut, I tell ya.
Huh? Over this pass with flat tires...? H-hey, wait, Maguruma-san!
Dammit! They stuck us with a fake!!
Sorry, Ban-chan. It's all because I didn't check...
No use whining about it. We've gotta catch them, period.
The roads to N Hall are closed to traffic. That big truck shouldn't be able to get in.
Which means...
There they are, Ban-chan!!
Heh, we meet again, you two GetBackers.
Hah, I was hoping never to see you again as long as I live, but whatever.
Bring it on, Jackal!!
I would love to fight you both, but Lady Poison has given me orders...
Regrettably, I must take my leave for now.
You're running away, punk?!
Dammit, we're catching them before they reach N Hall, Ginji!!
Got you cornered!
Hand it over quietly... Like that'd ever work on you guys!
Brace yourself, Ginji!
Yeah, leave it to me, Ban-chan!!
I can't let you have the cargo here.
This smell... Regression Perfume! Ginji, don't breathe it...
Ook? Ook-ook!
Falling for the same trick again and again, never learning... Hey, wait, dammit!
Wake up already, dammit! They're getting away!
Oh! Whatever has happened here? And for some reason, I have these in my hand...
Got the Ban-Bane Memory and the Bane-Gin Memory!
Ban-chan... what are these? Does the M stand for Me-mo-ry...??
How should I know?! Never mind that, we gotta chase 'em!!
Tch, looks like they already got inside. After 'em!
Huh, where'd they go? I don't see them anywhere.
At this hour, the public entrance should be closed.
The only way in or out is this staff passage, so they've gotta still be inside.
Got it, let's look for them!
So you're the ones who came to steal the costume.
We can't let you go any further!
Hah, this oughta be fun! Try it if you think you can!!
...Looks like these guys were paid off by this Hakama, whoever that is.
Well, whatever. If sparks fly my way, I just brush 'em off.
You there! You're late!
? Huh?
You're just part-timers, and you show up late? That won't do.
Honestly, we've got so much work piled up...
...You've got the wrong...
(Shh, just shut up and listen! This way we can sneak in without looking suspicious.)
You're starting right away. First job: taking drinks to each dressing room.
The rooms from the right: Tsuruko-san, Kikyo-san, Shizuku-san, Namio-san,
Kokoro-san, Rokuro-san, and Hakama-san...
Got all that so far?
(...Ban-chan, I'm already lost...)
(We'll manage without remembering a bunch of names...)
Okay, I'll go in order. First, Tsuruko-san in the first room gets coffee...
...no, she can't drink coffee. Milk tea.
Kikyo-san in the next room watches her health, so vegetable juice.
Shizuku-san in the next room gets coffee with sugar and milk.
Namio-san in the next room gets coffee with sugar but no milk.
...No, wait, that's backwards. Milk, no sugar.
Then Kokoro-san in the next room gets orange juice.
Rokuro-san in the next room gets lemon... Huh, that's not right.
Tsuruko-san gets lemon tea, and Rokuro-san gets milk tea.
And last, Hakama-san gets oolong tea.
I'll put the drinks in your Event items.
Careful, you can only set items down from in front of the table.
Got the canned drinks!
Relax, nobody's counting on your memory...
But now we can search out in the open, can't we?
Though those guards from before look like they'll come after us...

Done? Then here's your next job.
Next, I want you to put two flowers in each room.
So first, Tsuruko-san loves roses, so a rose and... a lily.
Next, Kikyo-san's full of pep, so a tulip and a sunflower.
Next, Shizuku-san is cute, so a gerbera and a tulip.
...No, maybe I'll make that lavender.
Next, Namio-san's fine with anything, but let's go with a sunflower and a tulip.
Next, Kokoro-san gets lavender and... what should the other one be?
Hmm, let's see... let's go with a rose.
Next, Rokuro-san gets a sunflower and a tulip.
And last, Hakama-san gets... Huh? Don't we have any roses left?
...Then drop Kokoro-san's rose and give her a lily.
So Hakama-san gets a rose and a tulip. She gets mad if there's no rose.
I'll put the flowers in your Event items.
Careful, you can only set items down from in front of the table.
Oh, and you can't stack flowers on top of each other.
Okay, I'm counting on you.
Got the flowers!

Uh, um... I don't remember......
Heh, that's just like you, Ginji-san.
Sure is.
